paragraphs.text:
Norman  and  Sylvia  follow  you  in  silence.  You  suspect  they 
think you obsessive, for continuing after the loss of Bernard 
and Charlie. You do not try to explain yourself.

Along your trek, you come upon a gorge and elect to follow it. 
A mile or so upstream, you find a crevice in the mountainside, 
the  source  of  the  stream.  Since  the  creek  runs  rapidly  here, 
it will be hazardous to attempt to wade through in order to 
explore the valley beyond.

If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. 
To pitch camp and rest before retracing your course, go to 124. To try 
to wade into the hidden valley, go to 125.
